evidence.computation: Exact rational elemental mass shares computed from parsed formula counts and the embedded periodic table; a successful composition has nonzero total mass and shares summing to 100 before display rounding.
assumptions: The question denotes one molecular formula, not a solution, mixture, alloy or sample.
Embedded atomic masses are the supplied PubChem decimals, not independently established physical facts.
untrusted: Natural-language recognition and selection of a formula from the question.
The original periodic-table source and its import.

evidence.computation: Radioactive-decay amounts and fractions use the typed exponential decay law and checked numeric enclosure; missing required quantities produce a decline. The public typed interface rejects negative elapsed times and amounts.
assumptions: The named isotope or stated half-life identifies the intended single-exponential model.
untrusted: Natural-language intent, isotope-name recognition, unit and quantity-role extraction.
